mapper.select: SELECT game_id, skill_category_key, name, description, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skill_categories WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_category_key = #{skillCategoryKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.skill_categories WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND lower(btrim(name)) = lower(btrim(#{name}))
AND skill_category_key <> #{excludeSkillCategoryKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.skill_categories SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = now() WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_category_key = #{skillCategoryKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.skill_categories WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_category_key = #{skillCategoryKey}
